- Throughput estimate: initial steady-state 120 qps embedding/rerank calls during business hours; spikes to ~350 qps for batch runs.
- Acceptable latency SLO: p95 <= 350ms for text-gen endpoints; embeddings p95 <= 120ms.
- Integration: they will push events via internal webhook and expect structured JSON responses for downstream pipelines.

Open items I need CS + Eng to own:

2) Technical kickoff to validate API contract and test data ingestion needs.
3) Finalize acceptance test harness and success criteria (matching SOW).

Please propose a CS owner and an engineering technical lead — Ben and I will remain the primary commercial contacts.

Looping in technical context from infra/serving runtime:

- Deployment recommendation: start on Dedicated with a fallback to Hosted for non-production traffic during onboarding. Dedicated node pool can meet the p95 latency need if we provision nv8/16 equiv per map. We should size for peak bursts of 350 qps; consider autoscale policy with 30% headroom.
- KV / prefix caching: customer is doing a lot of repeated lookups in their pipeline; enable prefix cache and short TTLs to keep latency low.
- Quantization: we can propose an int8 variant for cost controls but we'll need to verify quality on the acceptance prompt set.
- Security: SOC2 artifacts are available; I'll attach the internal checklist for audit evidence collection in the intake.

Risks:
- If procurement delays access to sample data beyond 5/12, our acceptance window tightens and mid-June go-live becomes unlikely.
- VPC peering + routing can add 3–5 business days to setup depending on customer's networking team capacity.

I'll volunteer to be the technical lead for the onboarding and will block time for the intake the week of 5/13. Please confirm your preferred slot (Marissa / Jonas).
